使用方法

1. 左侧“参考素材开关”逐路控制8张图、2个音频、1个视频。启用=参与生成，关闭=静音整组，不加载该素材。
2. 原有图片1–4默认启用；图片5–8、音频1–2、视频1默认关闭。新增素材先上传，再打开开关。
3. “参考图片分辨率”统一控制8路图片百万像素，默认1 MP；每路按原图比例缩放，尺寸取32倍数。0.5/1/2 MP可按需调节。
4. H3的ref_image_size默认max，避免match按生成视频面积再次压低参考图分辨率；H3仍会将超大的参考图限制到短边2048。
5. 视频强制24fps、最多360帧；选取2–15秒素材。只连接画面，不引入视频原声，独立音频始终为两路。
6. 关闭中间图片后，H3会按当前启用顺序重新编号Picture；请同步调整提示词中的Picture/Audio/Video编号。
7. 依赖：rgthree-comfy（Fast Groups Muter）、VideoHelperSuite（VHS_LoadVideo）及原工作流依赖。
8. 保留原UNET配置；使用参考条件时请在UNETLoader确认本地选择的模型为H3 ref2va权重。

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the middle-aged Chinese swordsman from <Picture 1>, “古风侠客三视图服饰设定.png”: angular face, dark eyes, mustache and pointed beard, black topknot with a horizontal hairpin, layered weathered brown-black robes, cloth waist sash and dark shoes. The three views depict one man.
<Subject 2> is the sword and matching scabbard from <Picture 2>, “微信图片_20261011010902_899_10.png”: a long silver-edged blade with a deep-blue central structure, elaborate silver dragon-shaped guard, dark-blue grip and blue ornamental accents.

summary:
[reference generation] A 10-second cinematic fantasy martial-arts performance featuring <Subject 1> wielding <Subject 2> on a mountain training terrace at dawn. He activates a foot-level lightning formation, gradually forms crystalline armor, performs two powerful Qinglong sword movements, and finishes with a controlled circular recovery.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain his identity, facial hair, hairstyle, robe layers, colors and footwear. Newly formed armor overlays the robes without replacing them.
<Subject 2> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain the sword’s blade length, silver and deep-blue structure, dragon guard and matching scabbard. His right hand holds the grip throughout; the scabbard hangs securely behind his left hip.

detailed_description:
Cinematic photorealistic Chinese fantasy, natural dawn lighting, weathered fabric and detailed metal surfaces. Restrained blue-white lightning preserves clear facial features and readable sword movement.

[Shot 1] One continuous 10-second shot. A slightly low, three-quarter frontal full-body composition reveals <Subject 1>, the brown-black-robed swordsman, centered on a broad stone mountain terrace. Distant ridges recede through pale morning mist. <Subject 2> is already drawn in his right hand, its dragon guard and blue blade structure clearly visible; the tip points forward and downward, clear of the ground. The camera remains on the same side of his movement axis, maintaining a 30–60-degree oblique view with space around the complete blade.

From 00:00.000 to 00:01.200, he bends his knees and settles his hips. His left index and middle fingers join at chest height, then point toward the stone before his feet. A circular formation illuminates beneath his soles before lightning particles emerge. The camera slowly pushes in a little, keeping both feet and the sword tip visible. A low electrical hum rises beneath the mountain wind.

From 00:01.200 to 00:03.300, lightning particles climb from his feet along his legs, waist and torso. A thin electrical lattice forms first; separate crystalline plates then assemble across his chest, shoulders and forearms. Each region forms progressively. His face, topknot and hanging robe edges remain visible. Tiny stones lift beside his boots. Delicate electrical crackles accompany the assembly. His left hand withdraws outward as the final plates settle.

From 00:03.300 to 00:05.500, he performs Qinglong Tail Sweep: his left foot slides laterally and his right foot follows. Hip rotation drives the sword from outside his right rear flank through a broad waist-height arc, continuing into an upward cut ending at chin height. His left arm counterbalances away from the blade. The camera trucks with him, retaining his full body and the complete sword arc. Cloth trails behind his turn; a broad blade whoosh marks the sweep.

From 00:05.500 to 00:07.800, he draws the sword toward the outside of his right shoulder, pushes from his rear foot and advances into a left-foot-forward bow stance. His torso drives one decisive diagonal cut from upper right to lower left. His legs and core brake the blade before its tip reaches the stone. The camera tracks backward smoothly. A sharper air-cut sound and a firm footfall emphasize the strike.

From 00:07.800 to 00:10.000, his rear foot closes the stance. He guides the sword through a broad circular recovery outside his torso, draws the grip toward his lower abdomen and settles with the blade angled forward and upward, away from his face. The camera slowly pulls out. The formation’s supply point follows his foot positions, maintaining the armor. His gaze remains steady while robe hems settle, plate-bound arcs flicker and suspended stones drift through the final frame. Only one man and one sword remain visible; the empty-air cuts produce no collision sparks.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous mountain wind, soft robe movement, grounded footfalls, synchronized sword whooshes, a low formation hum and fine electrical crackles. No dialogue, narration or vocalizations.

bunny_workflow.purpose: MiniMax H3 martial-arts motion, temporal continuity and clean low-noise finishing
bunny_workflow.name: BUNNY Combat H3

two_stage_sampling_notes.tuning: If still soft, raise split denoise from 0.25 to 0.30 or reduce stage-2 Turbo to 0.10. If motion weakens, lower split denoise to 0.20.
two_stage_sampling_notes.stage_1: Original Turbo 0.7 + Combat 1.0; high sigma branch; preserves motion logic.
two_stage_sampling_notes.stage_2: DisableNoise; Turbo 0.25 + Combat 0.70; final 25% low sigma branch; restores detail.
